title: fix(app-shell): a failed comments or activity read on a record page shows a load-failure notice with a Retry, not the empty state
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3KMJXK7TVJeUmNs3XdWYn3)_

Fixes #29188

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页的评论读取或活动读取失败（5xx 或网络断开）时，讨论面板、「动态」面板和「动态」标签页不再显示「暂无评论」/「暂无活动记录」，而是显示「无法加载此记录的评论/活动」并带「重试」按钮；读取失败期间「动态」标签不再显示数字 0。重试只重新读取失败的那一半。
- **为什么改**：staging 上托管环境的评论读取持续返回 500（cloud#3485），页面却显示「暂无评论」，用户以为自己写的评论丢了，故障只能在开发者工具里看到。
- **风险与回滚**：低。被拒绝（401/403）、空结果、404、接口被对象禁用和 400 的处理都与之前相同；只有 5xx 和无状态的网络失败走新状态。`@object-ui/react` 的 `DiscussionContextValue` 和时间线组件新增三个可选成员，均为加宽。附件面板 main 上已经能显示失败与重试，本 PR 只加了测试。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `feedReadVerdictOf` 与 `handleRetryFeed`，以及 feed effect 里的 `retrying` 分支；② `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` 的 `failedNotice`；③ `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx` 的计数置空。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.feedLoadFailure-29188.test.tsx`，预期 10 个测试全绿，覆盖评论 500、活动 500、重试、空结果对照、拒绝对照和附件 500。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A record page's comments read and activity read each end in one of three verdicts per source: `answered`, `refused` or `failed`. Before this change a read could only be refused or not, so a 5xx fell through to the empty state.

- **`failed`** is a 5xx, or a rejection with no status at all (the request never got an answer): `classifyLoadError`'s `network`, minus the 4xx statuses it also folds there (`feedReadVerdictOf` in `RecordDetailView.tsx`). A 404 (a table the deployment does not serve), an object that withholds its API (`api-disabled`) and a 400 (`rejected`) stay `answered`, as before. `refused` is unchanged (`isRefusedFeedRead`, objectui#11195).
- **The notice.** `RecordActivityTimeline` draws "We couldn't load the comments for this record." / "…the activity…" (zh: 无法加载此记录的评论。/ 活动。) with a Retry button, in place of the empty state when no rows came back and above the rows when some did. This applies to the panel, the 动态 tab (`stream`) and the 动态 panel (`peek`). Only the i18n sentence is rendered: no status code, no server text. The header count, the collapsed chatter label and the 动态 count (`record:activity`'s reported count and `RecordTimelineCountProbe`) are unknown (no number) while a read has failed, as for a refusal.
- **Retry** (`handleRetryFeed`) re-reads only the failed sources, directly through `dataSource.find`, never the page payload (which already answered). It does not touch the stream count the payload gave. The button is disabled while the re-read is in flight over rows on screen, and a retry that fails again keeps the notice.
- **Wiring.** `DiscussionContextValue` (`@object-ui/react`) gains the optional `activityFailed`, `commentsFailed` and `onRetryFeed`. `record:activity` and `record:chatter` forward them, and `RecordChatterPanel` and `RecordActivityTimeline` take them as optional props. A host that sets none of them renders exactly as before.
- **Locale keys**: `detail.activityLoadFailed`, `detail.commentsLoadFailed` and `detail.retryLoadFeed` in all ten packs (en, zh, ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru) at the en place, worded as each pack's `attachmentsLoadFailed` / `retryLoadAttachments`, plus the provider-less defaults in `useDetailTranslation.ts`. The eight non-en/zh packs came in claim amendment 2, after `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` went red on Test UI 14/16 at 89ec072d.
- **Attachments**: no code change. Measured on main, a 500 on the attachments read (payload part or direct GET) already shows `RecordAttachmentsPanel`'s "We couldn't load the attachments for this record." with a Retry, and the count store holds no value, so no badge is drawn. The payload path is now pinned.

## Contract review

Seat self-review, per the 10:43Z triage ruling. Every addition is optional and additive; no member is removed, renamed or narrowed.

| Surface | Addition | Default when absent |
|---|---|---|
| `DiscussionContextValue` (`@object-ui/react`) | `activityFailed?: boolean`, `commentsFailed?: boolean`, `onRetryFeed?: () => void` | no failure state, no Retry |
| `RecordActivityTimelineProps` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) | the same three props | `false`, `false`, no Retry button |
| `RecordChatterPanelProps` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) | the same three props, forwarded | as above |
| `detail` locale namespace (`@object-ui/i18n`) | `activityLoadFailed`, `commentsLoadFailed`, `retryLoadFeed`, in all ten packs | n/a (every pack carries them) |

No spec, metadata or wire shape changes; the server's page payload is read as before.

## Pins changed

- `RecordDetailView.feedRefusal-11195.test.tsx`, "a 500 is not \"no permission\"": an activity 500 now shows the load-failure notice instead of the empty state. It still asserts the no-permission line is absent.
- `RecordDetailView.feedLoading.test.tsx` (claim amendment 1, test only): its rejections were bare `new Error('403 FEEDS_DISABLED')` / `new Error('404 sys_activity')` with no status. A statusless rejection is what a network failure looks like, so three rows went red. Each rejection now carries the status its message names, in the ObjectStack client's shape (`httpStatus`, `code`), as the 11195 test already does.
  - "leaves the loading state when a feed read REJECTS (both rejecting)": the comment read is a real 403 now, so the panel settles on the comments no-permission line (objectui#11195's behaviour for a 403 since that card) instead of the empty copy. The no-spinner assertion is unchanged.
  - "leaves the loading state when only one read rejects and the other resolves empty": the activity 404 carries its status and keeps the empty copy. Assertions unchanged.
  - "leaves the loading state when both reads reject" (authored discussion node): the same as the first row.

## Tests

- New `RecordDetailView.feedLoadFailure-29188.test.tsx` (10 tests). It uses the real `ObjectStackAdapter` over a held transport, the `RecordDetailView.recordOpenOneRequest-28470` rig, under StrictMode. It covers a comments 500 as a payload part and as a direct GET (notice, Retry, no empty copy, no leak, 动态 tab with no count), Retry re-reading only `sys_comment` directly (no activity re-read, the notice gone once it answers), a retry that fails again, an activity 500 both ways, the empty-200 controls both ways, the 403 refusal control (no-permission line, no Retry) and the attachments payload 500 pin.
- New `RecordActivityTimeline.loadFailed-29188.test.tsx` (9 tests), through the real en and zh packs and the `record:chatter` block under a host `DiscussionContext`, plus the `peek` face. It covers the notice in place of "No comments yet" (zh: 无法加载此记录的评论。, never 暂无评论), Retry calling the host, rows kept with the notice above them, the activity line, no Retry when the host offers none, a refusal and a failure side by side, the empty control, and the disabled Retry while loading.
- **Measured before the change**, on main db6b4084, with a temporary copy of the 28470 rig (deleted before code): comments 500 → "No activity recorded" and an `Activity0` tab badge; attachments 500 → the panel's unavailable state with Retry and no count.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `feedReadVerdictOf` forced back to `answered` for a 5xx): 7 of 17 red across the new page test and the 11195 file. Those are the six failure rows and the flipped 11195 row; the controls, the refusal row and the attachments pin stayed green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Related sweep** from `ui/` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `--maxWorkers=2`, at merged head 89ec072d: the 109 test files that name the timeline, the chatter panel, `DiscussionContext`, the feed renderers or the refusal flags, plus the `RecordDetailView` tests that read `sys_comment` / `sys_activity` / the payload / the timeline, plus the two new files. 111 files, 2609 tests, exit 0. `apps/console/src/__tests__/record-block-record-reach.test.tsx`: 13 passed.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 13 changed files: 0 errors; the warnings are the files' existing `any` and hook warnings.
- At 53d0b774 (the eight locale packs): `packages/i18n/` suite 95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped, exit 0; `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` with the timeline test: 54 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Claim 6576137247, amendment 1 (`RecordDetailView.feedLoading.test.tsx`, test only) and amendment 2 (the eight other locale packs). The diff stays inside them.
- The verdict reads `classifyLoadError`'s `network` kind and then excludes the 4xx statuses that kind also holds, so a status-carrying 404 keeps the empty state the feedLoading pins describe. This matches the claim's "5xx or network" reading.
- An object that withholds its API (`api-disabled`) or answers 400 still shows the empty state, as the claim keeps. Neither is retryable, so a Retry would be wrong advice there.
- Premise check: the issue's attachments half does not reproduce on main (see Tests); it is pinned rather than changed.
